liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (2 reviews): Cited as a strong part of a great first set; Reviewer calls the Jed one of the better ones [17][23]
- **Dancin' in the Street** (2 reviews): Described as tremendous; Reviewer says it nearly set the speakers on fire [17][24]
- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Tight opening version of about eight minutes, with Phil taking several breaks; reviewer asks if it's the best ever [22]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Singled out as a nice version in a hot first set [24]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Reviewer's personal highlight of the night [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-11-30.sbd.clugston.miller.fix-3118.33215.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 192 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd79-11-30.sbd.miller.29424.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 194 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Excellent recording: Phil's bass is loud and clear, drums well captured, both guitars distinct, Brent audible; Mix puts Brent out front, with Phil's bass distinctive, crisp sound and great instrument separation; Recording contains a little static but is overall very nice [20][21][22][23]
- **gd79-11-30.sbd.clugston.3118.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 192 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboards from this run crackle with minor flaws but have strong quality and intimacy; The matrix has a tape flip during Scarlet > Fire, which the reviewer counts against it; A long audience patch runs from the end of Playin' into Drums [13][18]
- **gd1979-11-30.sbd.miller.95832.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 193 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [6]
- **gd1979-11-30.148526.fob.naks.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 198 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer turned seven on the day of this show and attended a first Dead show eleven years later [14]
- Reviewer attended both Stanley nights, 11-30 and 12-1, calling the Stanley a great venue [15]
- Reviewer says Jerry was still in good voice, with strong performances of old and then-new songs [20]
- Reviewer considers the Stanley one of the better venues for seeing the Dead [22]
- Presented as the setup for the following night's show on 12-1-79, which the reviewer considers the knockdown [13]
- With 11-9-79 in Buffalo, these were the reviewer's first shows hearing Brent, who played well all tour [15]
- At 24 songs it runs longer than the usual 20; reviewer says it isn't overshadowed by the next night [17]
- Reviewer prefers this show to the following night's [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-11-30.sbd.clugston.miller.fix-3118.33215.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR [1]. Also: Master audience cassette, taped with Nakamichi CM700 mics into a Sony TC-158, supplies patches for the soundboard; Audience patches cover El Paso, Scarlet Begonias, and Playin' in the Band into Drums, about 7:24 total; Charlie Miller fixed the soundboard-based files, noted 1/13/04 [1]
- **gd79-11-30.sbd.miller.29424.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd79-11-30.sbd.clugston.3118.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1979-11-30.sbd.miller.95832.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [6]. Also: Remaster of shnid 29424; a front-of-board Sony ECM-990 cassette master supplies Playin' in the Band from 12:28 to track end; Pitch correction was done with help from Joe B. Jones; disc changes are seamless [6]
- **gd1979-11-30.148526.fob.naks.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: 1st Set: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony TC-158 (in the pit) 2nd Set: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes;… [7]

- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [the Grateful Dead's Bob Weir -- 11/30/79 or 12/1/79 Stanley Theater, Pittsburgh](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3080228587/) [26]
